reviews.title: Doesn’t work
reviews.text: Claims that the schedule will repeat when you input days however every time i put in days somewhere down the line it messes up and says i have off when i have work or says i work when i have off, once they fix it ill use this app

reviews.title: Random work schedule change.
reviews.text: Great and super easy to use app however the set schedule randomly changes which made me miss work once and go in when I wasn’t scheduled. I’m usually good at detecting random schedule change like right now as I’m writing this review I have to work on fixing it BUT it’s harder to detect when I’m away from work for more than a month. Please fix it

reviews.title: Great till it messes up
reviews.text: Calendar is super easy to use.  very easy to set up a schedule and immediately identify my overtime. However, the app will randomly decide to lose track of the schedule and shift days on and off to the incorrect dates. they fix this issue. I will change my review.
